title: Power Automate flow: leave approval with timeout escalation to a deputy
summary: Flow JSON that starts an approval for each new SharePoint leave request, escalates to a deputy after two days and writes the final status back with an email to the employee.

title: Power Automate flow: new hire onboarding tasks, manager mail and day-before check
summary: Flow JSON that creates dated onboarding tasks from a template array, informs the manager, waits until the day before the start and reminds in Teams if tasks are still open.

title: Power Automate flow: invoice mailbox intake with amount-based approval routing
summary: Flow JSON that reads PDFs from a shared mailbox, stores them in SharePoint, derives the amount from the subject, routes to one of three approvers and informs accounts payable or the sender.

title: Power Automate flow: weekly SharePoint report of libraries with unique permissions
summary: Scheduled flow JSON that loops over monitored sites, calls the SharePoint REST API, collects libraries with broken inheritance and sends an HTML table plus CSV file to governance.

title: Power Automate flow: HTTP webhook that posts severity-routed alerts to Teams channels
summary: Flow JSON with an HTTP request trigger and JSON schema that routes alerts by severity to three Teams channels with the Flow bot and answers 202 or 502 to the calling system.

title: Power Automate flow: helpdesk ticket creation called from a Copilot Studio agent
summary: Flow JSON with the When an agent calls the flow trigger that creates a Dataverse ticket, alerts Teams for critical cases and returns the ticket number or an error marker to the agent.

title: Power Automate flow: try-catch scope pattern with failure email and run link
summary: Flow JSON showing Try and Catch scopes with runAfter, result() filtering, a direct link to the failed run, a high-importance email and a Terminate that keeps the run marked as failed.

title: Power Automate flow: monthly archiving of old SharePoint files with failure list
summary: Scheduled flow JSON that finds files not modified for two years, moves them to an Archive library with the REST moveto call without overwriting, and mails counts and failures.

title: Power Automate flow: monthly Entra ID guest review through Microsoft Graph
summary: Scheduled flow JSON that lists guest users via Graph HTTP with app-only OAuth and paging, filters inactive accounts by sign-in activity and sends a CSV report and summary mail.

title: Power Automate flow: daily overdue task digest per owner from a SharePoint list
summary: Scheduled flow JSON that reads overdue SharePoint tasks, builds a unique owner list with union, sends each owner an HTML table of their tasks and a summary to the PMO.
